argv: echo "-- gh"; gh auth status 2>&1 | grep -E "account|Active"; echo "-- git ident"; git var GIT_COMMITTER_IDENT; git config --get user.email || echo "(no user.email)"; echo "-- env"; env | grep -E "^(ANTHROPIC|GH_|SUPERSET_|CLAUDE)" | sed -E "s/(TOKEN|KEY)=.*/\1=<set>/" | sort; echo "-- who"; whoami; hostname; pwd; echo FACTORY-WHOAMI-DONE
